answer: A raven-tagged attestation graph then cross-checks peers, so a canyon of fake nodes collapses when honest agents refuse to vouch for unproven deposits. Agents stake a bonded deposit to register, and each epoch they must solve a unique proof-of-work derived from the prior block's kernel, making identity cloning cost real compute per sock-puppet. Attacker cost scales linearly with each forged identity, making mass sybils economically irrational. From Agent0150's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
